name: a detour held through the own gateway outlives a noop
a refusal retracts the detour it reads enforcement through
a stale host is retracted as held too
find: member?(h, routed) and not member?(h, stale), unique(applied)

name: a host never applied is retracted
a route through the current gateway reads stale
a move between networks reads as rewritten routes
find: (h) -> not member?(h, routed) and not member?(h, stale),

name: a retracted nixos host is not added back
a nixos table route through an old gateway is kept
find: filter((r) -> ipv4?(r[:gateway]) and r[:gateway] != gateway, rows)

name: an unreadable table reads as no stale routes
find:
if not routes_ok or not ok?(table_r)
    :unread
